item: A law source refused by its robots.txt reads 'blocked by the site's robots.txt' on every Law surface, never as a fetch error, a failure or an empty document (row 283, row 72's unowned part)
key_paths: src/law/track.py; src/static/app-gov-law.js; src/static/locales/*.json; tests/test_law_robots_named_row283.py; tests/test_law_robots_unread.py; tests/law_deferred_node_test.js
summary: The Law table badge said 'robots-blocked' shorthand, Add & track printed the stored 'fetch error: robots.txt disallows ...' text, and Track changes now counted robots refusals in its error total. Now one label table (lawVerdictLabel) feeds the badge and the add message; track_document labels the RobotsDisallowed/RobotsUnavailable it already caught (robots: blocked/unread) and both batch tallies carry robots_blocked/robots_unread (skipped_offline's convention: present only when non-zero, still inside errors); the toast takes them out of its error count and names them. No new egress, no change to what is fetched. 3 strings x12, the old 'robots-blocked' key removed. Release line: Law sources refused by their own robots.txt are now shown as blocked by the site's robots.txt, and Track changes now no longer counts them as errors.
